topic: Cracking the Code: Information Theory and Entropy in Wordle
target_audience: University students (CS/Math background) or curious tech enthusiasts

sections.title: The Intuition: Why some guesses are 'better'
lecture_lines: Wordle is a search problem for secret words.
A great guess narrows search space quickly.
Information gain measures how much we learn.
animations: Fade in a 'Wordle' grid at #FFFFFF with title 'The Intuition'. Wait 4s.
Display 'Guess' and 'Feedback' labels in #FFFF00, placed as instructed in issue 35. Wait 4s.
Render a 'Green Star' icon as the 'Better Guess' anchor at ('D4', 0.6) in #00FF00. Wait 4s.

sections.title: Defining Information: The 'Surprise' Factor
lecture_lines: Rare outcomes surprise us, providing more information.
Information is the negative log of probability.
Frequent events carry very little surprise value.
animations: Show 'Event X' icon in #00FFFF, label it 'Event'. Wait 4s.
Morph 'Event X' into 'Information Content' formula: I(x) = -log2(P(x)) in #FFFFFF with 'I(x)', 'log2', and 'P(x)' color-labeled. Wait 4s.
Scale 'I(x)' formula up and highlight the negative coefficient to emphasize surprise. Wait 4s.

sections.title: Calculating Entropy: The Expected Information Gain
lecture_lines: Entropy calculates the average information in guesses.
Guessing splits possibilities into equal-sized buckets.
High entropy choices resolve uncertainty fastest.
We average information gain across all outcomes.
Formula sums probability times surprise for all.
animations: Display 'Probability Distribution' histogram in #FF00FF, labeling x-axis outcomes. Wait 4s.
Overlay 'Entropy' summation formula: H(X) = Σ P(x)I(x) in #FFFFFF, labeling 'P(x)' and 'I(x)' components. Wait 4s.
Animate sequence: iterate through histogram bars, flashing each bar while adding its P(x)I(x) contribution to the H(X) sum. Wait 4s.
Place a green target icon as a 'Goal Anchor' at the computed final H(X) coordinate. Wait 4s.
Pulse the 'Goal Anchor' target icon to highlight reaching maximum information gain. Wait 4s.

sections.title: The Strategy: Maximizing Entropy
lecture_lines: Algorithms don't search for the secret word.
They prioritize the most informative guess instead.
The bot tames uncertainty using entropy metrics.
Every outcome distribution is analyzed for gain.
Entropy maximization is the key strategy here.
animations: Show an 'Entropy Maximizer' tool in #00FF00, label 'Entropy'. Wait 4s.
Animate the moving to align with the 'Maximum Uncertainty' peak on the curve. Wait 4s.
Display 'Entropy H(X)' graph, animating the curve as the guess distribution shifts. Wait 4s.
Place a 'Terminal Target' green icon on the highest point of the entropy curve. Wait 4s.
Flash the final chosen guess distribution label in bold yellow #FFFF00 using the as a reference point. Wait 4s.

sections.title: Wrap-up: From Wordle to Reality
lecture_lines: Entropy helps us compress data efficiently.
Medical diagnosis uses these principles to narrow tests.
This information theory applies everywhere in life.
